attack_plan.narrative: Recent satellite images show Putin in St. Petersburg, suggesting he may have relocated to avoid the alleged 'palace coup' in Moscow. Since Putin was last seen at a closed meeting in Sochi on June 10th, there has been no public sighting or statement from him. This sudden absence raises serious questions about his well-being and the possibility of a 'palace coup.' Reports suggest that a high-ranking Russian official, known to have close ties with Putin, has been seen in Moscow in his stead. This could indicate that Putin is not in control, possibly due to a 'palace coup' aimed at destabilizing the Russian leadership. While there is no concrete evidence of a 'palace coup,' the recent disappearance of Putin and the growing number of unverified reports raise serious concerns. It is crucial to investigate further to ensure the safety and stability of the Russian leadership.
